main_text.l: let enim factum aliquod reprehendi: quia
turpe & inhonestum: quia cū damno vel
publico, vel priuato coniunctum: quia dif-
ficile, ac periculosum: quia rarū, inusitatū,
à nullo ante, aut paucis, iisque improbis
sufceptum. Vtile autem in eiuscemodi sa-
ctorum vituperatione Aristotelis est præ-
ceptum, qui monet, vt factis vitiorum no-
mina imponamus, & μεταχρηματισμῷ
transfiguratione quadá vtamur. Tractatio atq;
collocatio ita instituenda: vt in exordio
cum dolore quodam atque indignatione
scriptionis susceptæ causæ indicetur: par-
te altera factum ipsum reprehēdatur atq;
exaggeretur: tertia occurratur iis quæ pur
gandi causa adferri posse videntur: postre
ma, adhortatio, aut territatio adhibeatur.
Exemplum tale esse poterit.
I. Etsi perinuitus faciam, te vt reprehendam: &
si quisquam alius à vituperationibus abhorreat: ta-
men amicitiæ nostræ fides ac religio requirit: vt vi-
tuperare hoc te tempore minimè verear.
II. Quid enim per Deum immortalem agis, aut
quid tandem cogitas?
III. Nemo à vobis ad nos venit (veniunt aut plu-
rimi) quin de tua auaritia ac tyrannide conquera-
tur: idem multorum bonorum ad nos perscriptæ li-
teræ confirmant.

Greek word in the paragraph beginning "let enim" (μεταχαρακτηρισμῷ-type term) is read as printed as far as the scan allows: "μεταχρηματισμῷ" is uncertain and marked here as [?] in spirit, not in the text. Printed "sactorum" in the sentence "Vtile autem in eiuscemodi factorum" is copied as printed; the scan shows "fa" followed by a catchword-like break, so the reading may be "factorum" with a line-end hyphen missing. Ornamental "trans-figuratione" is set with a hyphen at line end and joined here.
